component.name: Inline
component.description: Horizontal flex container. Arranges children side-by-side with consistent spacing from the space.inline token scale. Wraps by default when children exceed the container width.

useWhen: Arranging items side-by-side with consistent spacing
Displaying a group of buttons, tags, or chips that may wrap to a second line
Building a toolbar row, breadcrumb trail, or action bar

notFor.case: Using Inline for vertical content flow
notFor.because: Inline is always a row. Vertical stacking belongs to Stack.

patterns.name: form-actions-row
patterns.description: Primary + secondary button pair at the bottom of a form.

patterns.name: tag-group
patterns.description: A wrapping row of label chips or filter tags.

patterns.name: nav-bar
patterns.description: Top navigation with logo on the left and actions on the right.

useWhen.default: Row flex container with configurable gap, alignment, justification, and optional wrapping.
